fact: The DISD director said on 2 July 2026 that Côte d'Ivoire's computerised patient records (2 million records, 541 facilities) are hosted exclusively in the State's Tier III National Datacenter.
title: Forum Club Santé 2026 : La DISD fixe le cap de l'Intelligence Artificielle en Côte d'Ivoire
publisher: Direction de l'Informatique et de la Santé Digitale (DISD)
